C1092.title: UC Big Font Edition News Feed Allegedly Contains 'Black Five' Advertisements
C1092.summary: MIIT rules require senior-friendly apps to prohibit advertising plug-ins, inducive buttons, and ad pop-ups to protect older users. Some reports focus on commercialization and feed advertising in senior-friendly apps, warning that large-font or senior-oriented apps that mix high-risk ads such as medical beauty or health consumption into content feeds can mislead older users and weaken the public-interest purpose of accessibility adaptation.
